newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo precious metal market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo precious metal market closed for holiday.

text.p: The Tokyo precious metal market is closed for a national holiday on Monday. Trading will resume on Tuesday.
On Friday, yen-based gold futures ended three yen lower to six yen higher, with the benchmark April 1998 contract down one yen at 1,383 yen per gram.
Platinum futures ended steady to lower, with the benchmark April 1998 contract down four yen at 1,476 yen per gram.
Palladium futures were mixed, with prices ranging from two yen lower to six yen higher. Benchmark April was up one yen at 607 yen per gram.
